description: Calculate the adsorption energy of CH3OH (methanol) on the CeO2(111) surface.
user_prompt: Calculate the adsorption energy of methanol CH3OH on the CeO2(111) fluorite surface (Fm-3m). Note that on stoichiometric CeO2(111) methanol adsorbs dissociatively. Report the final adsorption energy Eads (in eV), defined as Eads = E(slab+CH3OH) - E(slab) - E(CH3OH), referenced to the intact gas-phase methanol molecule.
